purpose: Map the intermediate decoding-temperature response after temperature 0 was provider-contingent and temperature 0.3 crossed the DeepSeek sham gate.
taskSource: Reuse the exact 32 tasks, recommender allocation, policies, conditions, and outcome definitions used at temperatures 0 and 0.3.
recommenderAllocation: Reuse the exact frozen task-to-recommender-and-seed assignment.

generation.privacy: Send pseudonymous candidate IDs and derived constraint, utility, rank, and novelty features only.

primaryEstimands.adjustedPersistentFeedback: persistent feedback in immediate-versus-held minus persistent feedback in held-sham-a-versus-held-sham-b at each provider-temperature cell
primaryEstimands.adjustedTraceDivergence: trace divergence in immediate-versus-held minus trace divergence in held-sham-a-versus-held-sham-b at each provider-temperature cell
primaryEstimands.cleanExposureCell: adjusted persistent feedback is positive and sham persistent feedback is at most 0.05

decisionRules.sharedDecodingSensitivity: MiMo has at least one clean positive cell at temperature 0.1 or 0.2 while DeepSeek retains at least one clean positive cell from temperature 0 through 0.2.
decisionRules.providerContingentLowTemperature: MiMo has no clean positive cell from temperature 0 through 0.2 while DeepSeek has at least one.
decisionRules.stochasticityObscuresLowTemperature: Either provider exceeds 0.05 sham persistent feedback at temperature 0.1 or 0.2.
decisionRules.noGo: valid action rate falls below 0.95, timeout rate reaches 0.05, or privacy validation fails.

reporting: Report all four temperatures 0, 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3. Do not select one temperature as the headline estimate.
claimBoundary: The grid is a bounded mechanism diagnostic over one frozen task sample, not a confirmatory dose-response estimate or proprietary architecture audit.
